key_insight: LLM inference speedups are not portable by default: benefits depend jointly on the optimization, runtime, hardware capabilities, and workload.
engineering_relevance: For local inference on Apple Silicon, benchmark optimizations under single-request workloads rather than assuming NVIDIA server gains will transfer.
method: Evaluate KV-cache pruning, speculative decoding, ported GPU kernels, and post-training quantization.
Use a common single-request decode workload across four Apple machines.
Compare against an RTX 4090 where matched evaluations are possible.
evidence_signal: KV-cache pruning achieves up to 1.75× end-to-end throughput on Apple and transferable kernel components up to 1.20× decode throughput, while all evaluated speculative decoding methods reduce throughput under the common Apple benchmark.
watch_item: Public Metal lacks asynchronous copy, batch-one decoding limits serving-oriented optimizations, and quantization gains vary by machine.
paper_title: Evaluating the Applicability of LLM Inference Optimizations on Apple Silicon
